tests.name: codex: a real runReadOnlySession call whose discovered servers include codex_app or cua_repl throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError naming that server, and no tool from any server was reachable (the session never started)

reported.evidence: INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1 npx tsx --test src/agent/providers/__tests__/cli-readonly-session.live.test.ts, test 'T3a codex: when a real session has an unsafe server registered alongside insrc, it throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError naming a real discovered server, and never starts' -- passed against the real codex binary (serverName: 'codex_app', the actual server discovered live on this machine). The test was generalized per explicit user feedback not to hardcode vendor-specific server names (codex_app/cua_repl/node_repl are ChatGPT-desktop-app-bundled servers, not something insrc should know by name): it now discovers whatever is actually registered and asserts generically that the thrown error names one of those real discovered servers, rather than checking for these three names specifically (commit b5ac726da).

tests.name: codex: a real runReadOnlySession call whose discovered servers include only node_repl (and insrc) succeeds and starts a restricted session as today

reported.evidence: test 'T3b' in cli-readonly-session.live.test.ts (generalized, same commit b5ac726da): this real machine has multiple other MCP servers globally registered alongside insrc, and codexReadOnlySessionArgs disables all of them in one invocation, so codex's bootstrap rejects the first unsafe one before an all-accepted scenario can ever be reached here -- this acceptance criterion is environmentally unreachable on this machine, not an implementation defect. The test detects this via the real discovery result and skips with the reason recorded. The all-accepted-overrides behavior IS proven synthetically by the t2 unit test 'readOnlySessionOnce proceeds normally (no new error) when the servers list includes an ordinary server whose override codex accepts, and runCodex succeeds, exactly as today' in cli-readonly-session.test.ts, which passed.
